A '''Ranger star''' was a symbol worn by the members of the [[Je'daii Order]] that marked the rank of the [[Je'daii Ranger]]. The symbol was made in the form of a miniature metal star. Je'daii Rangers usually placed the star on their belts or other prominent places; they were recognized by such a star by the [[Padawan (Je'daii)|Padawans]] and the civilians among whom Rangers spent time on their assignments outside their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. In order to blend in with the crowd and not give away their status, Je'daii Rangers hid their Ranger star.<ref name="Into the Void" />
